def generate_paths(n, k, a, b, c, d):
    if k < n - 1:
        return -1
    
    # Generate the first path
    v = list(range(1, n + 1))
    v[a - 1], v[b - 1] = v[b - 1], v[a - 1]
    v[c - 1], v[d - 1] = v[d - 1], v[c - 1]
    
    # Generate the second path
    u = list(range(1, n + 1))
    u[c - 1], u[d - 1] = u[d - 1], u[c - 1]
    u[a - 1], u[b - 1] = u[b - 1], u[a - 1]
    
    return v, u

# Read input
n, k = map(int, input().split())
a, b, c, d = map(int, input().split())

# Generate and print the paths
paths = generate_paths(n, k, a, b, c, d)
if paths == -1:
    print(-1)
else:
    v, u = paths
    print(*v)
    print(*u)
